propositions: Current clarity_score duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py rewards volume and legacy shape rather than author guide leaf/container contract, inviting drift and enabling pass-through of padded tickets lacking Approach, grounded Scope, or per-criterion verification.

Deterministic additions lacking from clarity measure include required-section shape keyed on graph altitude, per-AC verification coverage with proved_items ratio, placeholder detection in Scope/Approach, grounded edit-set with structured file_impact, AC text hygiene at item level, and Testing shape markers when Testing is declared.

Author guide and authoritative G6 criteria conflict on whether rejected-alternative prose is required; current guide requests it but G1G2/G6 do not, creating ambiguity until bug 828a-7407-9d68-4b82 is resolved.

Scoring should replace raw length/any-bullet points with named applicable checks returning per-check evidence and derive compatibility score from satisfied/applicable checks rather than adding points to existing seven-point scale that allows filler to compensate for missing required sections.
